messages:
alex: Heads-up — just opened a tiny follow-up on the tracehook dashboard PR, adding one metric name tweak and a short lint fix. Trying to get it into the canary slot this afternoon. Can someone scan quickly?

mira: on it, pinging briefly. link?

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-console/pull/5421 — branch: feat/tracehook-metrics-rename

jeff: skimming now. is this just rename or any schema change for telemetry?

alex: just a rename + a tiny aggregation tweak (sum -> max for a peak latency gauge). no schema migrations, should be safe for dashboards.

sam: quick note — backend emits `trace.processing.latency_ms` as float, dashboards expect `trace.processing.latency_p95` etc. this rename looks fine but we should add a compatibility alias for one release.

alex: good call. added an alias line in the collector `metrics_map`:
```
"trace.processing.latency_p95": "trace.processing.latency_ms",
```
keeps old dashboards working for one deploy.

mira: that code looks fine. small nit: can we add a comment explaining alias and removal timeline? ex: `# remove after 2026-10 rollout`

alex: yep will add comment. also fixed the linter failures from CI.

deploy-bot: CI passed for feat/tracehook-metrics-rename — all checks green. commit 3c4f2b9

jeff: left two tiny review comments about test names. not blocking.

sam: +1 for merge once alex adds the comment. canary window at 15:30 PT today, so if you push the comment + squash before 15:10 we can queue it.

alex: pushing comment now. thanks all — will squash and request merge. @mira @jeff @sam appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

mira: ack, will watch the canary. good to go after squash.

jeff: cool. post any fallout on #incidents if dashboards act weird during canary.

alex: will do. spreading the note to ops channel too.

deploy-bot: Merge requested for PR #5421. Merge queue position: 2.

sam: thanks — handing off.

alex: thanks everyone!
